features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: The rites of your circle grant you the ability to transform into mightier animal forms. While in a Wild Shape form, your AC equals 13 + your Wisdom modifier if that is higher, and you can expend a spell slot when you Wild Shape to gain temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times the slot's level. The maximum Challenge Rating of beasts you can assume equals your Circle Forms value.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.description: Your connection to the moon's cycle grants you spells that are always prepared: Cure Wounds and Moonbeam.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: While in a Wild Shape form, you can use a Bonus Action to expend a use of Wild Shape to regain Hit Points, and you add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to the damage of your Wild Shape attacks.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: You can use a Bonus Action to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, gaining Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses on a Long Rest, and you can expend a spell slot to regain one use.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: The power of the moon suffuses your animal forms. While in a Wild Shape form, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack, you deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage. You can also use Moonlight Step to teleport a willing creature within 5 feet of you alongside you.
